verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only mentions a generic 'receipts' API endpoint (navan-docs-2) without any documentation of photo capture, email-forward ingestion, or OCR matching to transactions. No first-party or hands-on evidence describes the receipt-capture workflow described in the story, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence. Missing for 10: documentation of mobile photo capture, email-forward-to-receipts flow, OCR extraction, and automatic transaction matching.
